selection.scope: New blocked starting settings conditional on a previously seen atlas; halos exclude prior origins, not all prior destinations. Blocks are descriptive resampling units, not independent populations.
selection.partition_rule: Recursive widest-normalized-axis weighted median; coordinate ties intact; alpha wins axis ties; lower cut wins split ties; centroid-nearest representative with row/column ties; no replacements
selection.exclusion_order: EXP-006, EXP-007, EXP-008; each manifest sorted by alias ID; first physical occurrence

claim_boundary: Exploratory75-unit loss versus charged preview budget in24 atlas-selected fresh origins. No task-quality margin, guaranteed geometry advantage, measured deployment-speedup,300-unit utility,full shrimp-boundary topology or trained-network generalization claim.
